notes:
{採掘|さいくつ} refers specifically to mining or extracting natural resources from the earth for commercial purposes.

WRITING:
- {採|さい} (gather, collect, take)
- {掘|くつ} (dig)

USAGE:
- {採掘|さいくつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to mine - suru verb)
- {採掘|さいくつ}{権|けん} (mining rights)
- {採掘|さいくつ}{場|じょう} (mining site)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦{石炭|せきたん}→石炭：03755_sekitan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採掘|さいくつ} (coal mining)
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採掘|さいくつ} (gold mining)
- ⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採掘|さいくつ} (oil extraction)
- ⟦{鉱石|こうせき}→鉱石：22249_kouseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採掘|さいくつ} (ore mining)
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}ガス→天然ガス：19038_tennengasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採掘|さいくつ} (natural gas extraction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧: archaeological excavation or talent discovery
- {採掘|さいくつ}: commercial extraction of natural resources
- ⟦{掘削|くっさく}→掘削：08011_kussaku⟧: drilling (often for oil/gas wells)
